steps.text: Half a month later

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Thank you for all you've done, Cohen, Kötz, Tina, Alexsandr.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: On behalf of... The town of Long Spring...

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not so good with this kind of formal language.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Thanks to you, I survived the conflict with my brother, and my people were able to return to live on their land.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We were only doing what had to be done.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We started this, so it's our responsibility to end it.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: If it weren't for my irredeemable brother, none of this would've happened.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I would have liked to offer you a reward.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: But, as you can see, our town has been destroyed.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Anything we have left, I want used to rebuild Long Spring.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: A cash reward... is beyond my power to give you.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: But anything you may want from this home is yours to take.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: I think we will have to tear it all down and build a new Long Spring with the survivors.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: About that.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Alexsandr?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: This helmet fits well. Can I keep it?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Uh huh.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Really, the nail tips are so blindingly bright, I'd like to put one on my shield so I don't need batteries anymore.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: That's enough for us. We're satisfied.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: That's... that's all?

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: My weapons, my father's heirlooms, you can—

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No thanks. You need them more than we do.

steps.name: Picale
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let's go. We should leave now.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Mister Kötz......

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You're finally done.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Did you say goodbye to the Lord?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Then it's time for us to go too.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: My team will cover your return to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Miss Cohen, your squad is coming with us, right?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Right. We've been fighting too long. We need a place to rest and resupply.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: And most importantly, we probably need some identities.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Identities we can go around the world with... around Terra.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Stormeye
steps.text: The car's ready. We're off.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Your information has been registered with Rhodes Island. You may stay and resupply at Rhodes Island field offices, or safehouses across Terra.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: Although you are not official employees of Rhodes Island, the mission network is open to you and you will be paid for contracts you complete.

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: That's about it. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Just real quick, I have to ask, does Rhodes Island have any sci-fi literature?

steps.name: Human Resources Operator
steps.text: I'm sorry?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: So these are our new identities.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: At least I've got a shield I can use. Could be worse.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Do we have a plan?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Try to take a look at this world, which we now know too little about.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I'd like to have a detailed writeup myself.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: But this time, I'm sorry.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's all up to us.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: So where's our first destination?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Somewhere called Siesta. Sounds like a pretty good city.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Then let's get going.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Until we make it back home, we're on the road.
